== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Han Seeker (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1210_84</code>, Virtual Block 1 slip 84E), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-84E-Han_Seeker.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-D-hanseeker-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Han Seeker (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Use 1 Force to deploy to an unoccupied site. Deploys and moves like an Undercover spy. If present with [Permanent Weapon] Han or a smuggler of ability < 3, this weapon and that character are lost ('all cards' situation).”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1001_L6343</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>1_316</code>, title, lore, icons, slip number 84E, Virtual Block 1 set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
